title: i could throw a party over finding this sub
content: oh my gosh. hi everyone. I am so excited about finding you all and have been reading everyone's posts. brief intro - always been an intense dreamer, every night. characters and plots, all that jazz. sadly i rarely lucid dream (in the way that i have control) but i sometimes know i'm dreaming and kinda "watch". I have a whole dreamland where many of my dreams take place. over time i've pieced it all together and mentally mapped it out (and i'm happy to share a drawing if anyone's interested). i think it's because i've always had really strong spacial awareness maybe? anyways. i have mall dreams probably once a week. there's two in my dreamworld, one is a huge, long, narrow, multi-level, roofless(?) mall sort of carved into a mountain? it's pretty and bright and always busy. you have to take dreambridge to get there (very long and scary bridge over the ocean lol). the other is usually in an anchor / department store that feels kind of detached from the dreamland mall. still figuring that one out. anyway thank you if you took the time to read this. i'm so stoked to tell my bf that i found this sub, he's going to be so happy for me because i talk about this all the time lol. please feel free to comment and tell me about your dreams recently i'd love to read them :)
